description: 西西里防御 B57 — 异侧易位对攻，速度决定一切

intro.popup_en: Castling, Lesson 4: Opposite-side castling creates an attacking race. Black castles kingside and White queenside; both sides push pawns toward the opposing king.
intro.popup:
王车易位第4课
异侧易位对攻！
黑方短易位
白方长易位
双方向对方王翼冲兵——争取优势！

outro.popup_en: With White castled queenside and Black kingside, White attacks with g4, g5, and h4 while Black advances ...a5, ...b4, and ...b5. Both sides must attack quickly and try to gain the first breakthrough.
outro.popup:
异侧易位总结
白长易位对黑短易位：
① 白方g4/g5/h4冲击黑王翼
② 黑方a5/b4/b5冲击白王翼
③ 双方都加快进攻速度，争取先手！

moves.popup_en: Nxd4 recaptures and occupies the center.
Bc4 develops the bishop to an active square.
Be3 prepares Qe2 and queenside castling.
...O-O! Black castles kingside and secures the king on g8. White is about to castle queenside.
moves.popup:
O-O！黑方短易位
王到g8，安全！
但是……白方下一步要长易位

moves.popup_en: O-O-O! White castles long. The kings are on opposite wings, c1 and g8, creating the classic opposite-side castling setup. Both sides can attack the opposing king.
moves.popup:
O-O-O！白方长易位！
现在双方王在对面：
白王c1——黑王g8
这是异侧易位的典型局面
双方要向对方王翼冲兵！

moves.popup_en: ...a6! Black begins the queenside pawn storm and prepares ...b5 or ...b4 against White's king.
moves.popup:
a6！黑方开始冲
准备b5/b4进攻白王

moves.popup_en: Bb3 retreats the bishop and avoids a possible ...Na5 attack.
...Na5! The knight attacks Bb3 and eyes c2, beginning Black's attack against White's king.
moves.popup:
Na5！马跳出
攻击Bb3，瞄准c2格
黑方向白王发动进攻

moves.popup_en: g4! White launches a kingside pawn storm. Both sides attack at once, and White advances toward Black's king.
moves.popup:
g4！白方也冲兵
速度极快，双方同时进攻
白方向黑王翼冲兵！

moves.popup_en: ...b5! Black continues the attack. Neither side gives ground in the race.
moves.popup:
b5！黑方跟进
双方对攻，互不相让

moves.popup_en: g5! White drives the pawn toward Black's knight on f6. Speed is everything in opposite-side castling: the first side to break through may win.
moves.popup:
g5！白方兵暴推进
直扑f6马
速度决定一切！
谁先突破，谁先获胜！
